newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna stocks bounce higher to end at 11-week high.
newsitem.headline: Vienna stocks bounce higher to end at 11-week high.

text.p: Austrian shares extended gains on Monday to end at levels not seen in over 11 weeks.

Shaking off a weak start, the ATX index ended just off the day's high at 1,054.19, up 5.38 points or 0.51 percent and traders said they expect the market to continue its upward trek despite only selective buying interest.
"With good market conditions," said one, the ATX could climb towards 1,070/80 points.
"But we could do with higher turnover," said another, pointing out that demand was restricted to a few issues, namely VA Stahl, VA Tech, Creditanstalt preferred stock and Verbund.
Of the 21 blue chips, 11 advanced, eight fell and two were unchanged by the close.
Championing the gainers was insurer EA Generali's ordinary shares, up 3.05 percent at 3,070.8, while heading decliners was Radex, losing 2.17 percent at 293.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index jumped 2.59 points, or 0.64 percent, to 408.19.
The October ATX contract closed at 1,053.0 points against Friday's 1,053.5 on turnover of 461 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
